title: Top Lawn Mowers: Gas, Electric & Robotic (2026)

method: Picks were made by cross-referencing recommendations from Bob Vila, Tested Gear Hub, CNET, and Consumer Reports, prioritizing products mentioned by multiple sources or holding top awards.
assumptions: Prices are not included as they are not stated in the provided source excerpts.
